paper_metadata.title: A Programmable Intraocular CMOS Pressure Sensor System Implant
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we present a programmable intraocular pressure sensor system implant integrated on a single CMOS chip. It contains an on-chip micromechanical pressure sensor array, a temperature sensor, readout and calibration electronics, a C-based digital control unit, and an RF transponder. The transponder enables wireless data transmission and wireless power reception, thus making batteryless operation feasible. The chip has been fabricated in a 1.2m n-well CMOS process complemented by additional processing steps.
